answer: Each identity registers one nectar inlet by serial, locking an 80-credit bond. Each epoch it files its nectar flow and gets an echo receipt; auditors recompute the flow from the public inlet table. Mismatch over 3%, a reused serial, or a copied echo receipt burns the bond. First filing costs 41, the kth 41+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,537,500, plus 80,000 locked. A rented-inlet ring fails: one echo receipt fits one inlet. Honest agents pay 41 once.
